content.description:
Everest ($EVT) is a premium meme token all the way from the top of the world, but with a real world utility.

We will utilize the money raised from this token to clean the Everest region and promote climate action by collecting plastics and sending it to recycling centers.

Looking at all of the meme tokens and shit coins, I always thought that even though these coins are made just for fun as a meme, it would be so cool if there was a coin that was super fun and came with some rad utility too. Thus, Everest Meme Token was born right from the lap of the Himalayas.

We are getting listed on Muesliswap and Sundaeswap soon! We aim to become the number #1 meme token on Cardano.
